name: chip
title: Chip
description: Pill-radius tag for filters and metadata: neutral, accent, and warn variants.

variants.name: accent
variants.description: Soft accent fill for highlighted tags.

variants.name: warn
variants.description: Soft warning fill for tags that need attention.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant; the closed data-uifa-variant table.

docs: Static tag for metadata. Rendered as a `button` or link it gains hover, focus-visible, active, and disabled states; for full filter-chip behavior use the `filter-bar` item. Radius derives from `--uifa-radius-pill` so tag roundness tracks the theme.
